full_export: fantasy_current.json (same generated_at; full pools and history)
read_me: Bridge facts only; generated_at is when the data was pulled.
AVAILABILITY: a player is available in this league if and only if he is NOT listed in rostered_index. The 'available' lists are top-N samples, not the full pool.
rostered_index entries are 'Name POS NFL espn_id' (id as in the espn_id columns). Match on espn_id; same-name players differ by NFL team and id.
Tables use cols + rows; match values to columns by position.

usage: nflverse stats + PFR snaps, ok, thru wk 9, updated 2026-11-06T12:02+00:00; posts 1-2 days after games. thru wk = latest week with ANY game data (a Thursday game sets it); check each row's last_wk.
injury_report: official NFL report (nflverse), ok, wk 9, updated 2026-11-07T13:53+00:00.
usage_risers: available players up 10+ pts in snap % or target share (nflverse).

usage cols snap_lg, tgt_share_lg (offense) and def_snap_lg (IDP): % in the player's latest game (week = last_wk); nflverse, same freshness as usage. Only on Rob's roster rows: available rows stop at last_wk (their spikes are flagged in usage_risers.basis).

usage_risers basis: 'l3' = last 3 games up 10+ pts vs the 3 before; 'spike' = latest game 15+ pts above his prior-3 average (snap % or target share); both = 'l3'. Noise floor: latest snap % >= 40, or target share >= 12% or 8+ carries that game (tuned on weeks 4-6).

vacated_roles (pool file): starters (team snap leader at RB/TE/LB/DL/DB, top 2 WR; last-3 snap % >= 60 offense / 80 defense) who are Out/Doubtful (official report, only when it is this week's) or IR/PUP (Sleeper), with the next 1-2 teammates by last-3 snap % (RBs also by carries) who played the team's latest game and weren't already full-time. load = carries_pg_l3 (RB), tgt_share_l3 (WR/TE), tackles_pg_l3 (IDP). available = not on a roster in this league (null = can't match). ok: report wk 9; Sleeper IR/PUP 251.

intel: '(Bluesky)' sources are posts; beat writers, Rotoworld and Rapoport are news (reports), the rest are analyst takes listed after news. This run read 49/49 accounts. Dormant (30+ days silent): joejhoyt.bsky.social, elliottteaford.bsky.social, zberm.bsky.social, popesffh.bsky.social, garydavenport.bsky.social.
intel: 'ESPN News' items are news-tier relays (mostly Rotowire, naming the original reporter in the text) for Rob's rostered players, last 72h. This run read 64/64 players.
projections: wk_proj and ros_avg_proj are ESPN's own projections for this league (no Sleeper projections here). Rob's roster with a week projection: IDP 9/9, K 1/1; 0.0 usually means bye or out.
Available lists, rostered_index (availability), trending, risers and transactions are in fantasy_ai_shangri_la_pool.json (same generated_at). Read it for waiver and availability questions.

league.name: The Not So Football League
league.format: 10 teams, IDP (DL/LB/DB/DP slots), no D/ST, rolling waivers, no FAAB

usage.note: Row column 'usage'; DL/LB/DB use cols_idp. % values; last 3 games played, oldest first; trend vs prior 3 (+/-5 pts). last_wk = week of the player's latest game in the data. No routes/red-zone data.

injury_report.note: Rob's players on the report. practice = latest day only (no Wed/Thu/Fri split in source). Not listed = not on report.

box_score.note: Week 9 current_week. basis=current_week: games may still be in progress; basis=previous_week_final: the week is over (later stat corrections possible). pts null = unknown.
